searchText: Hi there. I'm just taking a look at EIP-7002 and inevitably flipping back to look at `partial-withdrawals` in EIP-7251. I think I'm looking at the latest spec (https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/a7fb2260ae2ea39bdd31886832c9e45452d0e76a/EIPS/eip-7251.md) and I noticed there was this scenario was written in it (in pink). I would've thought that it should 84 rather than 68? I always thought that auto-exit was only triggered once validator balance reached (or went below) 16 ETH... ? Hi all, are partial withdrawals available only via EL? Or is it possible via CL message like voluntary exits? Hey Kuhan, you can only make partial withdrawals for "excess balance" which is defined as the balance greater than the `MIN_ACTIVATION_BALANCE` (32 ETH). So the 68 ETH figure is correct here. See here for more details: https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/a09d0c321550c5411557674a981e2b444a1178c0/specs/electra/beacon-chain.md?plain=1#L1497 That's a good question. I could be wrong but I'm pretty sure partial withdrawals (for specific amounts) are only available via EL. Great. Thank you so much <@592004585506340885> um... but then how do you trigger a full withdrawal with the EL withdrawal request? <@502776248741658627> if I'm reading the spec correctly, you can specify amount=0 in your request it will trigger a full exit. See here: https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/a09d0c321550c5411557674a981e2b444a1178c0/specs/electra/beacon-chain.md#new-process_withdrawal_request namely `is_full_exit_request = amount == FULL_EXIT_REQUEST_AMOUNT` where `FULL_EXIT_REQUEST_AMOUNT = uint64(0)` Yes exactly 👍
